question:
Post: Junior Librarian

Eligibility Criteria (as on 01-04-2025):

Must have a Bachelor's degree in Library Science (B.Lib.Sc.)

Age must be less than 32 years.

Must have minimum 1 year experience in any library.

Case:

Rina is 31, has B.Lib.Sc., and has 18 months experience in a college library. What should be done in Rina's case?
solution:

 Eligibility criteria

 Yes, Rina has B.Lib.Sc
